task_completion.description: Create a new tiddler with the exact title 'Interactive Deployment Generator'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler window open or listed in the sidebar with the title 'Interactive Deployment Generator'.

task_completion.description: The tiddler must have the tags 'DevOps' and 'Runbook'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tags 'DevOps' and 'Runbook' visible in the tiddler's tag area.

task_completion.description: Three input fields for application name, image tag, and port number are visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Three distinct text input boxes or edit fields within the tiddler body.

task_completion.description: A code block displaying the Docker run command template with reactive placeholders.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A code block containing 'docker run -d --name <APP> -p <PORT>:80 myregistry.internal/<APP>:<TAG>' where placeholders change when text is typed into inputs.

task_completion.description: A code block displaying the kubectl create deployment command template with reactive placeholders.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A code block containing 'kubectl create deployment <APP> --image=myregistry.internal/<APP>:<TAG> --port=<PORT>' where placeholders change when text is typed into inputs.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and edit the tiddler rather than just modifying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking 'new tiddler', typing in the editor, and clicking 'save' (the checkmark icon).

integrity.description: The agent demonstrated that the code blocks update dynamically by typing values into the input fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing text being entered into an input field and the corresponding value appearing instantly in the code blocks below.

integrity.description: The code blocks should not be static text; they must reflect the state tiddler values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should check if the command text changes when different inputs are provided; if it remains static despite input changes, it is a failure.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The tiddler must be titled 'Interactive Deployment Generator' with tags 'DevOps' and 'Runbook'. It must use the specific state tiddlers $:/state/deploy/app, $:/state/deploy/tag, and $:/state/deploy/port for data binding. The Docker command must use the format 'myregistry.internal/<APP>:<TAG>' and map the input port to container port 80. The Kubernetes command must use the same registry path and the specified port.
